# Loops.so

The email platform for modern SaaS. A better way to send product, marketing, and transactional email.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/loops-so/.

## Actions

- **Create Contact**: Add a new contact to your Loops audience.
- **Find Contact** (read-only): Search for a contact by email or userId.
- **Get Contact Properties** (read-only): Retrieve a list of your account's contact properties from Loops.so.
- **Get Mailing Lists** (read-only): Retrieve all mailing lists associated with your Loops account.
- **Send Event**: Send events to trigger emails in Loops.
- **Test API Key** (read-only): Test API key validity and retrieve team information.
- **Update Contact**: Update an existing contact by email or userId.
- **Create Contact Property**: Add a custom contact property to your Loops team.
- **Delete Contact**: Delete a contact by email address or user ID.
- **Get Dedicated Sending IPs** (read-only): Retrieve a list of Loops' dedicated sending IP addresses.
- **List Custom Fields** (read-only): Retrieve a list of custom contact properties.
- **List Transactional Emails** (read-only): Retrieve a list of published transactional emails.
